final:
Of the 7 review comments, 3 are valid and worth fixing, 2 are wrong, 1 is only partly right, and 1 is a style preference. I wrote the verdicts to `verdicts.json` and made no code changes.

Most of the diff against the base SHA is unrelated history (operator, quarkus, and test-framework changes), so I only looked at the fine-grained admin permissions and client-permission files.

| # | Category | Verdict | Actionable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | CORRECTNESS | INVALID | NO | `ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ` and `_V2` are two versions of the same feature (`Profile.java:56,58`), so only one can be on. Under v2, `ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled` throws `UnsupportedOperationException` (`ClientPermissionsV2.java:193`). The guard at `AdminPermissions.java:77` deliberately avoids that throw when a client is deleted. |
| 1 | CONVENTION | VALID | YES | The new Javadoc says "Returns `true`" on the `void requireView()` (`ClientPermissionEvaluator.java:95-98`). The same mistake is on `requireViewClientScopes()` at lines 100-103. |
| 2 | CORRECTNESS | INVALID | NO | `PermissionClientTest.java:148` is inside a try block that expects `getDefaultClientScopes()` itself to throw `ForbiddenException`. A new client also gets several default scopes. |
| 3 | CORRECTNESS | PARTIALLY_VALID | OPTIONAL | At `PermissionClientTest.java:170-174` the test asserts the list is non-empty, then reads index 1. It works in practice, but the assertion doesn't match the index used. Test-only. |
| 4 | NITPICK | STYLE_PREFERENCE | OPTIONAL | `Arrays.asList(scope)` copies the style of `UserPermissionsV2`. `scope.equals(s)` would be simpler still. |
| 5 | BEST-PRACTICE | VALID | YES | `getEvaluationContext` (`ClientPermissionsV2.java:262-272`) is never called. Several imports (lines 22, 23, 29, 46) and the `logger` are unused too. |
| 6 | CORRECTNESS | VALID | YES | `getResourceName` (`AdminPermissionsSchema.java:304-326`) only handles Users. Clients resources are named by internal UUID and fall back to a missing display name, so they don't get a readable name like the "All users"/username shown for Users. |

The three to fix are 1, 5 and 6; 3 and 4 are optional.
